input_data.earnings_summary: CrowdStrike reported Q1 FY2025 results that significantly exceeded analyst expectations across all key metrics. Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) grew 33% to $3.65 billion, with net new ARR of $212 million. Revenue reached $921 million, up 33% year-over-year. Subscription revenue grew 34% to $872 million. Non-GAAP operating income hit $228 million (25% margin), up from $140 million a year ago. Non-GAAP EPS of $0.93 beat the $0.89 consensus. The company raised full-year FY2025 guidance with revenue guided to $3.976B-$4.011B (31-32% growth). CEO George Kurtz highlighted that CrowdStrike Falcon platform's AI-native architecture continues to win competitive displacements from legacy vendors including Palo Alto Networks, Symantec, and Microsoft Defender.

key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Q2 FY2025 revenue $958.3M-$961.2M; Full-year FY2025 revenue $3.976B-$4.011B
